Sam: CI red on PR #4212 — unit-typechecks (pyright) + format-check (rustfmt) failing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4212 :facepalm:
CI Bot: Build failed: unit-typechecks (pyright) • format-check (rustfmt) — https://ci.redwood.dev/build/9876
Priya: I can grab the pyright run. Sam, did you change any typing or proto gen?
Sam: only bumped proto gen. Pyright snippet:
```
src/storage/client.py:45: error: Incompatible return value type (got "Any", expected "Dict[str, Any]")
```
Alex: sounds like generated stubs use bare Any. Where are they located?
Sam: build/gen/python/storage_pb2.py has `def decode(...) -> Any:`. Also rust bindings at `crates/bindings/src/gen.rs` — rustfmt fails on trailing comma/newline diffs.
Jen: We usually exclude generated files from rustfmt via .rustfmt.toml's `ignore`, but that entry isn't present in this repo.
Dave: short-term: can we rerun the jobs with cache disabled to rule out flaky cached artifacts?
Priya: I'll start a git bisect to find the commit that changed proto-gen (starting point: 8a3f2b1).
Sam: Rerunning pyright now: `/ci rerun unit-typechecks --no-cache` (queued)
CI Bot: Rerun started by Sam (job: unit-typechecks) — https://ci.redwood.dev/build/9877
Priya: if rerun fails, we can patch the generator to emit typed return annotations (Dict[str, Any]) or add a post-gen fixer in the build pipeline.
Alex: I'll prototype a tiny generator patch to prefer `Dict[str, Any]` and open a hotfix PR. Should be quick.
Jen: I'll draft a `.rustfmt.toml` change to exclude `crates/bindings/src/gen.rs` and attach to the hotfix if needed.
Sam: thanks — will ping reviewers once the hotfix PR lands. :thumbsup:
CI Bot: Rerun finished — unit-typechecks: failed (same error). Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/9877/logs
Priya: bisecting now... will post results here when I have a candidate commit.
Alex: Opening hotfix PR 4215 to tweak generator output: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4215
Sam: added label `ci:hotfix` and requested reviewers.
Priya: bisect found the change — commit `8a3f2b1` introduced a template tweak that removed explicit dict typing. Adding bisect log to PR.
CI Bot: PR 4215 CI started — https://ci.redwood.dev/pr/4215
CI Bot: PR 4215 checks passed — all green :white_check_mark:
Sam: merged PR 4215, kicking a full CI re-run on the main branch.
CI Bot: Main CI re-run in progress — https://ci.redwood.dev/build/9885
CI Bot: Main CI build 9885 — all checks passed. :tada:
Jen: leaving a follow-up issue to exclude generated files from format/type gates and to add a post-gen typing sanity check.
Sam: resolved, thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Closing thread.
